paper: Lakonishok and Smidt (1988), Are Seasonal Anomalies Real?
sample: 1897-01-04 through 1986-06-11; preceding row supplies initial return only
calendar: Order actual recorded index sessions; preserve Saturdays; audit duplicates, nonpositive prices, date gaps and partial boundary months before calculation. Exclude incomplete calendar boundary months from four-day aggregate, disclose resulting count. No weekend filling.
estimator: Simple consecutive recorded close-to-close returns; per-position means and average monthly sum of four returns, not compounded. Show full-sample and pre/post June1952 descriptive splits.
numerical_gate: All four mean differences within 0.03 percentage points/day of published values and sum within 0.08 percentage points; count mismatch explicitly reported, prevents exact replication claim. These are reconstruction tolerances, not strategy success criteria.
inference: For complete monthly four-return sums, stationary bootstrap 10000 paths, blocks 3/12/24 months, seeds117003/117012/117024; CI for mean and contrast against four times average non-TOM daily return. No alternative windows.
advance: Positive contrast CI for all block lengths plus numerical gate permits separately registered post-publication test; no trading validation, tier ranking or paper order from this reconstruction alone.
